fields.description: Issue features a lead editorial and reporting alleging Miami Beach City Manager Renshaw protected a gambling syndicate and may face removal and possible criminal charges, including claims of misappropriation of public funds/materials and interference in police gambling enforcement. Additional editorials and columns oppose a proposed Florida sales tax and criticize state political leadership; report on FCC action to ban large radio giveaway programs; discuss hurricane warning broadcasts and disaster communications planning; note Florida teacher education statistics; and include local commentary, letters to the editor, entertainment/nightlife coverage, and advertisements.
